backend/main.mo: Actor managing user profiles, permissions, sports prop types, and edge/projection/verification data models.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to affected files, components, tests, and confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Collection of short summaries describing responsibilities of various frontend files and components.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variable definitions for light and dark mode UI styling.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML shell loading the React app with metadata and favicon references.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring routing, theming, query client, parlay state, and notifications.
frontend/src/components/auth/AdminOnly.t: Wrapper that conditionally renders children only for authenticated admin users, otherwise shows an access alert.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button using Internet Identity with automatic cache clearing and error handling.
frontend/src/components/error/ErrorState: Reusable error display component showing authorization-specific or generic error messages.
frontend/src/components/landing/DailyTop: UI component rendering the top daily parlay edges with player info, confidence, and add-to-parlay actions.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the main page layout with header navigation, footer, and parlay leg count badge.
frontend/src/components/loading/LoadingS: Shows a centered loading spinner with an optional message.
frontend/src/components/parlay/AddToParl: Button to add or remove a prop from the parlay, handling max-leg limits and tooltips.
frontend/src/components/parlay/CopySumma: Copies a text summary of parlay legs to the clipboard and shows success/error toasts.
frontend/src/components/props/Confidence: Displays a small badge indicating high confidence with size‑based styling.
frontend/src/components/props/PropBoardR: Renders action buttons for a prop row, including add-to-parlay and a link to the prop detail page.
Collapsible section showing confidence, edge data, projections, and verification summary for a prop.
frontend/src/components/props/ValueBar.t: Displays a confidence percentage bar with color reflecting edge direction.
frontend/src/hooks/mutations/useManualRe: Mutation hook to manually refresh backend data and invalidate related queries.
frontend/src/hooks/mutations/useSaveProv: Mutation hook to save ingestion provider config and refresh its query.
frontend/src/hooks/queries/useEdges.ts: Fetches all edges with their associated props, projections, and verification data.
frontend/src/hooks/queries/usePropDetail: Fetches detailed prop info including associated edges for a given prop ID.
frontend/src/hooks/queries/useProviderCo: Retrieves the ingestion provider configuration from the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/queries/useRefreshSta: Computes the most recent update timestamp from NBA player props.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance based on user identity, invalidating dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, managing identity state, login, logout, and AuthClient creation.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsAdmin.ts: Runs a query to check if the current authenticated caller is an admin using the actor API.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and theme variables, including light/dark mode colors and background textures.
Computes combined hit rate for a parlay by multiplying confidence scores and reports availability and missing values.
frontend/src/lib/parlay/exportSummary.ts: Generates a formatted text summary of selected parlay legs, including stats, confidence, and aggregated metrics.
frontend/src/lib/verification/highConfid: Checks whether a verification result meets the high-confidence threshold based on confidenceScore.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Displays informational content about Bobbypicks, disclaimers, and responsible gambling guidance.
frontend/src/pages/EdgeBoardPage.tsx: Shows a list of detected edges with confidence indicators, handling loading, errors, and empty states.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page highlighting top edges, a hero section, and feature highlights using fetched edge data.
frontend/src/pages/ParlayBuilderPage.tsx: Renders the parlay builder UI, showing selected legs, confidence info, combined hit rate, and controls to clear or copy summaries.
frontend/src/pages/PropBoardPage.tsx: Displays a searchable table of props with edges, confidence indicators, value bars, and actions to add props to parlays.
frontend/src/pages/PropDetailPage.tsx: Shows detailed information for a single prop including projections, edge data, confidence, and option to add it to a parlay.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Provides data refresh status and admin-only API key configuration with save functionality.
frontend/src/routeTree.tsx: Defines the application's route structure and maps paths to page components using TanStack Router.
frontend/src/state/parlay/ParlayProvider: Implements context for managing parlay legs, including adding, removing, clearing, and enforcing a max leg count.
frontend/src/state/parlay/types.ts: Defines the ParlayLeg interface describing data stored for each parlay selection.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, custom OKLCH color tokens, extended theme settings, and typography/container-queries/animate plugins.
project_state.json: Defines project metadata, architectural notes, and a list of existing features for the Bobbypicks full‑stack application.
